column1: 匕首提高携带者的暴击伤害。每个战场开打时，我方所有单位的下一次攻击必定暴击，并附带额外暴击伤害与生命偷取。档位越高，战斗中再触发的次数越多。
column2: Daggers grant their carriers Crit Damage. When each battlefield begins, the next attack of every allied unit is a guaranteed critical strike with bonus Crit Damage and Life Steal. Higher tiers trigger it again later in the fight.

column1: 仪式匕首的携带者每击杀一名敌人刻下一道血契。血契整个大轮累计，每道血契永久提高携带者与全队的攻击力。
column2: Each kill by a Ritual Dagger carrier carves a Blood Pact. Blood Pacts accumulate across the whole round, and each one permanently increases the Attack of the carrier and the whole team.

column1: 每件匕首为携带者提供 +6% 暴击伤害 · 【刺杀】每个战场开打时，我方所有单位的下一次攻击必定暴击，暴击伤害额外提高 {C:DaggerSynergySystem.EXTRA_CRIT_DMG[0]%}%，并获得 {C:DaggerSynergySystem.LIFESTEAL%}% 生命偷取

column1: 每件匕首为携带者提供 +12% 暴击伤害 · 【刺杀】额外暴击伤害提高至 {C:DaggerSynergySystem.EXTRA_CRIT_DMG[1]%}%，开打第 {C:DaggerSynergySystem.TRIGGER_GAP} 秒再触发一次
column2: Each Dagger item grants its carrier +12% Crit Damage · [Assassinate] bonus Crit Damage increased to {C:DaggerSynergySystem.EXTRA_CRIT_DMG[1]%}%, and it triggers again {C:DaggerSynergySystem.TRIGGER_GAP} seconds into the fight

column1: 【血契】携带者每击杀一名敌人，刻下 1 道血契，至多 {C:EqDaggerBatch.RITUAL_CAP} 道，整个大轮累计，大轮重置。多件仪式匕首共用同一份血契 · 每道血契使全队攻击力提高 {C:EqDaggerBatch.RITUAL_TEAM_ATK%}%
column2: [Blood Pact] Each kill by the carrier carves 1 Blood Pact, up to {C:EqDaggerBatch.RITUAL_CAP}. Pacts accumulate across the whole round and reset with the round. Multiple Ritual Daggers share the same Pacts · Each Blood Pact increases the whole team's Attack by {C:EqDaggerBatch.RITUAL_TEAM_ATK%}%

column1: 暗影匕首
column2: Shadow Dagger

column1: 召唤暗影忍者，影袭背刺生命值最低的敌人，半血时分出影子一起掷出手里剑。
column2: Summons a Shadow Ninja that backstabs the weakest enemy. At half health it splits off a clone, and both throw shuriken together.

column1: 登场时召唤一名暗影忍者：{C:EqDaggerBatch.NINJA_HP} 生命值、{C:EqDaggerBatch.NINJA_ATK} 攻击力、{C:EqDaggerBatch.NINJA_RES} 护甲和魔抗、{C:EqDaggerBatch.NINJA_CRIT%}% 暴击率，登场时隐身，攻击时现形。龟能满时释放【影袭】：化为黑烟，闪到生命值比例最低的敌人身后背刺，造成 {C:EqDaggerBatch.NINJA_STRIKE_MULT%}% 攻击力的物理伤害，必定暴击，随后隐身 {C:EqDaggerBatch.NINJA_RESTEALTH} 秒。暗影忍者的生命值首次低于其 {C:EqDaggerBatch.NINJA_CLONE_HP_PCT%}% 最大生命值时，分出一名影子忍者，持续 {C:EqDaggerBatch.NINJA_CLONE_SEC} 秒，拥有其 {C:EqDaggerBatch.NINJA_CLONE_STAT%}% 最大生命值与攻击力。影子在场时，每次【影袭】两名忍者各朝目标掷出一枚手里剑，对路径上的敌人造成（{C:EqDaggerBatch.SHURIKEN_FLAT}+{C:EqDaggerBatch.SHURIKEN_ATK%}% 攻击力）魔法伤害。
column2: On entry, summons a Shadow Ninja with {C:EqDaggerBatch.NINJA_HP} health, {C:EqDaggerBatch.NINJA_ATK} Attack, {C:EqDaggerBatch.NINJA_RES} Armor and Magic Resist, and {C:EqDaggerBatch.NINJA_CRIT%}% Crit Chance. It enters stealthed and is revealed when it attacks. When its turtle energy is full it casts [Shadow Strike]: it turns into black smoke, blinks behind the enemy with the lowest health ratio and backstabs it for {C:EqDaggerBatch.NINJA_STRIKE_MULT%}% Attack as physical damage. This is always a critical strike. It then stays stealthed for {C:EqDaggerBatch.NINJA_RESTEALTH} seconds. The first time the Shadow Ninja drops below {C:EqDaggerBatch.NINJA_CLONE_HP_PCT%}% of its max health, it splits off a Shadow Clone for {C:EqDaggerBatch.NINJA_CLONE_SEC} seconds with {C:EqDaggerBatch.NINJA_CLONE_STAT%}% of its max health and Attack. While the clone is present, each [Shadow Strike] makes both ninjas throw a shuriken at the target, dealing ({C:EqDaggerBatch.SHURIKEN_FLAT} + {C:EqDaggerBatch.SHURIKEN_ATK%}% Attack) magic damage to every enemy in its path.

column1: 黑曜石匕首
column2: Obsidian Dagger

column1: 暴击时把黑曜石匕首插进敌人身上，足以致命时一起拔出并回复生命值。
column2: Critical strikes lodge obsidian daggers in the enemy. Once they can kill, they are ripped out together and restore health.

column1: 造成暴击时，在目标身上插入一把黑曜石匕首，匕首不会自行拔出。目标身上全部匕首一起拔出的伤害足以击杀目标时，立即全部拔出：每把造成（{C:EqDaggerBatch.OBS_FLAT}+{C:EqDaggerBatch.OBS_ATK%}% 攻击力+目标 {C:EqDaggerBatch.OBS_MAXHP%}% 最大生命值）物理伤害，并为自身回复 {C:EqDaggerBatch.OBS_HEAL} 点生命值。
column2: Critical strikes lodge an obsidian dagger in the target; daggers never come out on their own. As soon as ripping out all daggers in the target would kill it, they are all ripped out at once: each deals ({C:EqDaggerBatch.OBS_FLAT} + {C:EqDaggerBatch.OBS_ATK%}% Attack + {C:EqDaggerBatch.OBS_MAXHP%}% of the target's max health) physical damage and restores {C:EqDaggerBatch.OBS_HEAL} health to the carrier.
